name: conversation
description: Scroll container for a chat thread. Sticks to the newest message while streaming and shows a jump-to-latest button.

properties.value: `log` region with `aria-live` so new messages are announced
Plain text, reachable by screen readers

constraints: Always provide an empty state with what the assistant can do.
Don't auto-scroll when the user has scrolled up — the component handles this; don't override it.

notes: Installed 2026-09-22 with AI Elements for the chat panel. Stock source adapted to Enpath: Phosphor icons, light-only classes, shadcn colour names rewritten to Enpath tokens.

docs.intro:
# Conversation

Scroll container for a chat thread. Sticks to the newest message while streaming and shows a jump-to-latest button.

sections.title: What it is
sections.body:
AI Elements Conversation (use-stick-to-bottom). Holds Message rows; ConversationEmptyState shows before the first message.

**Exports:** `Conversation` · `ConversationContent` · `ConversationEmptyState` · `ConversationScrollButton` · `ConversationDownload`
